items.why: Slipped below $84,000 after Iran stepped up tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz, lifting oil and the dollar. Rising Treasury yields and $547 million in liquidations added to the slide.
No single headline; caught in the broader tech sell off as surging yields pressure AI names. Wells Fargo set a Street high $1,000 target today but flagged a 2027 earnings trough.
Small caps are underperforming as higher for longer yields and weak consumer data weigh on the broader market.
Fell after Reuters reported a key EU vote on Full Self Driving approval was pushed back to December, delaying a subscription revenue catalyst.

market_note: Minutes from the Fed's September meeting land later today; traders are watching for hints on another rate hike.
summary: Stocks are sliding midday as the 10 year Treasury yield climbs to a fresh 24 year high, with the Dow down around 500 points. Bitcoin is leading risk assets lower as oil rallies and the dollar firms.
